## Strix Security Review

No security issues found.

<details>
<summary>Review summary</summary>

This PR closes a parameter-drift gap in the Memory async API: `aremember` now accepts `agent_role` and `root_scope`, and `aremember_many` now accepts `root_scope`, forwarding them verbatim to the already-existing sync `remember`/`remember_many` methods (which already accepted both). The change introduces no new logic beyond argument forwarding, adds no new sinks or untrusted-input handling, and makes no modification to authentication, authorization, storage, or event-handling behavior — the underlying data flow existed entirely in the sync path before this change. The remaining diff is test-only coverage for the new forwarding behavior. No security issues were identified in the changed code.

</details>

<sub>Updated for `9eadff1`.</sub>
